project.name: Job Market Intelligence
project.tagline: End-to-end ETL + analytics for job postings

nodes.label: Extractor
nodes.detail: Fetches raw job postings and emits transformed records

nodes.label: HTTP client layer
nodes.detail: API client wrappers (Adzuna, retry & rate-limit handling)

nodes.label: Adzuna API
nodes.detail: Primary external job postings source (requires ADZUNA_APP_ID/KEY)

nodes.label: Transformer
nodes.detail: Maps external schema into internal JobTransformed model

nodes.label: Enricher
nodes.detail: Orchestrates language detection, skill extraction, classification, country/currency/salary enrichment

nodes.label: Language Detector
nodes.detail: Uses lingua-language-detector library; caches results (ISO 639-1 codes)

nodes.label: Skill Extractor
nodes.detail: Keyword-driven skill extraction from title+description

nodes.label: Technology Scorer
nodes.detail: Rule/keyword-based scoring and classifier (policy-driven decisions)

nodes.label: Validator (Pydantic)
nodes.detail: Pydantic schemas validate enriched job payloads

nodes.label: Loader (Upsert + Purge)
nodes.detail: Performs upserts by source_id and purges jobs older than 90 days

nodes.label: Repository layer
nodes.detail: DB access abstraction (SQLAlchemy + Alembic migrations)

nodes.label: Postgres
nodes.detail: Primary persistence for jobs and analytics (DATABASE_URL)

nodes.label: Analytics service
nodes.detail: Aggregations and KPI computations for dashboard endpoints

nodes.label: FastAPI backend
nodes.detail: REST API exposing jobs and analytics; health endpoints and OpenAPI

nodes.label: API routes
nodes.detail: Routes implement filtering, pagination, and analytics endpoints

nodes.label: Streamlit Dashboard
nodes.detail: Interactive Streamlit UI that calls the FastAPI backend (no DB access)

nodes.label: Dashboard services
nodes.detail: Client layer + Plotly visualizations and caching

nodes.label: Docker Compose
nodes.detail: Local orchestration for backend, db, dashboard for development

nodes.label: Render
nodes.detail: Optional production deployment target (render.yaml)

nodes.label: GitHub
nodes.detail: Source repo, CI runs, workflows and actions
